notes: Spent most turns clicking for credits while rich and holding cards, and twice paid the Tollbooth toll then declined to break it although the 6 credits were there, letting 2- and 3-advanced agendas in Server 3 get scored. Repeated an IP Block run that could only fail again; Hard-Hitting News tag removal then drained the economy to zero before the final score.

Left R&D unprotected for four turns against a Runner running it four times a turn, giving up Global Food Initiative and Project Beale. After that, fast Breaking News scores and a slow but safe Global Food Initiative push from an iced remote won the game.
Aggressive and sensible central pressure with Ika handling Anemone, then Mad Dash plus multi-runs on R&D to close out by turn 5. Only oddity is a thin rig, which never mattered.

Clean Weyland game: iced remote scoring, Hostile Takeover money, then a Posted Bounty tag into double Scorched Earth for the flatline. A few low-value draw/credit clicks and one remote card left unadvanced.
Good early pressure on the open R&D and on HQ through Resistor with Paperclip, which won by turn 9. Stimhack was spent on an unprotected R&D run and some clicks went to low-value credits.

Clicked for credits nearly every turn up to 21 credits without installing or scoring anything, discarding agendas to an unprotected Archives. Then Audacity dumped HQ into Archives, letting the Runner win from Archives; Hard-Hitting News tags were never punished.

Forged Activation Orders to strip Hostile Takeovers was clever, but ran R&D into a known rezzed Archer with no killer (losing Yog.0) and fired Account Siphon into the same Archer. Later sat on 17-27 credits for several turns without rebuilding a decoder while the broke Corp scored out of Server 1 and 2.

After a strong turn 1 R&D dig, installed Femme Fatale targeting R&D ice and then never ran R&D again, clicking for credits for nine turns up to 38 credits. Barely contested remotes, letting the Corp score Efficiency Committee and two Accelerated Beta Tests.

Scoring in the iced remote was fine, but spent about eight turns clicking for credits up to 25 credits with a full hand, discarding every turn, one discard being Director Haas' Pet Project, which got stolen from Archives. Won despite the long stall because the Runner was equally passive.

Long stretches of credit-clicking and end-of-turn discards with a big bank, and the Rashida Jaheems went into naked remotes. Recovered well with the Blue Sun Chiyashi bounce-and-reinstall in front of a new remote, flatlining the low-grip Runner.

Efficient install-advance scoring through Enigma-protected remotes with Commercial Bankers Group money, winning on turn 8. Leaving HQ and early R&D open was risky (15 Minutes stolen) but the Runner could not exploit it.

A good early rig and SSL Endorsement steal, then repeated Stimhack and normal runs into the known Afshar, and for over ten turns ran the empty Archives four times a turn with an empty grip and 20+ credits. Ignored the advanced cards in Server 2, letting SDS Drone Deployment, Hostile Takeover and the final SSL Endorsement be scored.

Left R&D unprotected for six turns (two Project Beales stolen), then spent clicks and 2 credits at a time trashing Liberated Account turn after turn, keeping itself at 0-1 credits so HQ ice could not be rezzed. Remastered Edition was taken from HQ and Bellona was installed behind unrezzable ice and stolen.

Clicked for credits for about seven turns up to 51 credits while holding a full grip and never building a rig, so it had nothing to break Border Control. Did punish two naked remotes, but let Hostile Takeover, Offworld Office and the final Global Food Initiative go uncontested.

Good early steals and a fine Film Critic dive through four ice, but ran into the known Cobra on R&D six or seven times without breaking it, losing Cloak, Corroder, Houdini, Switchblade and SMC plus many cards. Ended passive on 16-20 credits while the broke Corp scored three agendas out of Server 1, and put Temujin Contract on an empty server.

Clicked for credits for six turns, discarding agendas into an unprotected Archives, then Consulting Visit fetched Audacity to trash the rest of HQ there. The Runner took four agendas from Archives in one run to win on turn 8.

Early Project Beale steal, then a mill-and-Archives plan with Data Leak Reversal that won. Kept taking Joshua B. tags and paying to clear them, and never ran R&D or HQ while the Corp sat at 0 credits for six turns unable to rez anything.

Built a heavily iced remote and scored Send a Message and Obokata, but lost one Send a Message through it and spent many turns, including six in a row, clicking for credits to 33 credits with a full hand and discarding. Won by flatline mostly because the Runner threw itself into Loki.

Clicked for credits instead of icing R&D on turn 1, giving up Global Food Initiative to repeated R&D runs, and scored Project Beale out of a naked remote overnight. Otherwise a sensible NBN game with fast Breaking News scores, Archangel use and a well-timed final score.

Never installed a breaker for Border Control and ran a one-card HQ four times in a row to re-see the same card. Ignored the singly-iced Server 1 agenda early, and in the last two turns sat clicking for credits up to 23 while the Corp advanced Global Food Initiative.
